Title: Public preview: Azure Machine Learning announcements for March 2022

Body.Content:
Azure Machine Learning’s first-class AutoML natural language processing (NLP) capability allows you to bring your own text data and train and deploy large-scale pretrained text deep neural network (DNN) models. This is for natural language processing tasks including multi-class text classification, multi-label text classification, and named entity recognition (NER) for your machine learning workflows. 

Users are now able to search for machine learning assets such as jobs, models, and components across workspaces in a unified global view. 

Azure Machine Learning will enable you to label content with text named entity recognition (NER).​ 

Additional resources:

  • How to auto train natural language processing models
  • Search for machine learning assets across workspaces
  • Create a data labeling project and export labels
